invariants.text: Canon chain is a single hash-linked list from trusted seed to current head.
Every canonical mutation has a receipt bound to its hash.
No block is canonical without explicit operator confirmation.
AI-origin content may appear in payloads, but never in authority fields.

membrane_rules.title: No Receipt, No Reality
membrane_rules.text: If there is no receipt, it never became real.

membrane_rules.title: Operator or Nothing
membrane_rules.text: Only a human hand can seal. Silence beats an untrusted signature.

membrane_rules.title: Exorcism by Receipt
membrane_rules.text: The cursed vault remembers every secret it swallowed. A receipt is the exorcism.

membrane_rules.title: Scratch Is Not Scripture
membrane_rules.text: Left side may dream. Right side only replays what was sealed.

membrane_rules.title: Goblins Do Not Hold Seals
membrane_rules.text: Goblins may whisper warnings, but they never hold the seal.

membrane_rules.title: Every Block Must Be Replayable
membrane_rules.text: If you cannot replay it, you cannot trust it. If you cannot trust it, you cannot keep it.

membrane_rules.title: No Secret Paths
membrane_rules.text: Any traveler with the map can find the vault again. No secret paths.

final_contract_line: All authority flows through the membrane. Every canonical fact is hash-bound, receipted, replayable, and recoverable through cw_recovery_log and reseedCanon().
